label: early original-phase token pair (prev in b/i/l/g/m/0, current in w/i/l/p/m/g/q/s)
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase at t=1..4 (99.7% of mass; t=2 alone is ~50%); never at t=0, at the delimiter, or meaningfully during copy. Within that window it depends on a combination of the current and recent input tokens: current input w (by far the strongest, 38% of mass, top activations are w at t=2 after b-i or b-b), or i/l/p/m/g/q/s, after a preceding b/i/l/g/m/0 (first token b is the strongest context). Magnitude is highest for w following b at t=2 and drops with later position. The token-set conjunction gets only about half of activations precisely; the unit looks like a soft token-combination detector for early positions, not a clean single rule.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: i, b, l, g, m, 0; least: v, 1, c, t) and the current input token, by step (t=1: w, i, l, m; t=3: w, i, l, p; t=2: w, i, p, l); timing cues that raise it most: t=2, t=3, L=4 & t=3.
